# Ian Ramy - Technical Profile Digest

## Identity & Core Value
Ian Ramy is a multi-disciplinary technologist operating at the intersection of Software Engineering, Data Science, and Cyber Security. He is the Co-Founder & CTO of MwangaLabs and the sole maintainer of RustyWoof.

## Technical Unification
He builds scalable software (Next.js, React, Rust, Typescript) that extracts actionable intelligence from big data (Machine Learning, Python), all fortified by zero-trust security principles (Threat Detection, SIEM).
